title: Orbital: Flight & EVA
description: Pilot a crewed spacecraft, dock at an orbital relay, complete a tethered spacewalk, then rendezvous with a lunar polar outpost.

defaultCaptions.x: Orbital: Flight & EVA — fly the relay mission, step outside for a repair, then make the long lunar approach.
defaultCaptions.facebook: A crewed spaceflight game with precision docking, a tethered EVA repair, and a lunar rendezvous.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Orbital: Flight & EVA — a short mission campaign built around piloting, docking and a spacewalk.
defaultCaptions.discord: Orbital: Flight & EVA — near-orbit service mission and a long-range lunar rendezvous.
